query:
-- Research Content table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS research_content (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  content_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  content_type ENUM('axis_overview', 'research_note', 'case_study', 'protocol', 'glossary') NOT NULL,
  lang VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'fr',
  status ENUM('draft', 'published', 'archived') DEFAULT 'draft',
  file_path VARCHAR(500),
  evidence_level ENUM('confirmed', 'probable', 'hypothetical') DEFAULT 'hypothetical',
  tags JSON,
  regions JSON,
  content TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX rc_slug_idx (slug),
  INDEX rc_axis_idx (axis_id),
  INDEX rc_type_idx (content_type)
);
